translation_en: I had double eyelid surgery (incisional) at Haneulbit Sinsa branch. Director Kim Do-yoon operated on me personally, and before the surgery they even had me sign a consent form for CCTV recording in the operating room. They initially quoted 1,800,000 KRW, but there was an event/promotion so I had it done for 1,500,000 KRW. The swelling had almost gone down by the second week, and the line looks natural, so I'm satisfied. Attaching a photo of the receipt as proof.

I had ptosis correction (eye shape correction) and epicanthoplasty (inner corner incision) at Onyu Plastic Surgery (온유성형외과). The director was really meticulous and I'm extremely satisfied with the result! The price was reasonable too. I recommend it!!

side_effects: left eyelid scar still somewhat red at 3 months
translation_en: This is my 3-month review of double eyelid surgery at Haneulbit Sinsa branch. The crease has settled, but the scar on the left is still a bit red. The director said he would do the scar laser for free, so I've arranged to get it next week.

I had breast consultations at two places, Onyu and Haneulbit Gangnam Station branch. Onyu quoted 6 million won and Haneulbit quoted 7.5 million won. In the end I had it done at Onyu, and I'm now 6 months post-op — the feel is natural and I'm satisfied.
